Covariate reference table

Source: R/covariate_catalog.R
covariate_info.Rd

The catalog as a data frame, for display in documentation or the app's covariate reference tab.

Usage

covariate_info(include_derived = TRUE)

Arguments

include_derived

also describe covariates computed by the pipeline rather than fetched

Value

a data frame with name, label, units, variable, dataset, spatial, temporal, and description columns

Examples

covariate_info()[, c("name", "label", "units")]
